scope: Local exact namesake follow-up, 2 May–1 June 2027 inclusive, LV/LT/EE. Existing name-origin evidence and uncertainty labels are preserved; this does not verify name histories.

people.method: Reconciled every under-five profile with complete cached national exact-title discovery and country/prominence outcomes from rounds 117–125. No broad Wikipedia or Wikidata query was repeated. Searched the shared private cache for 68 selected name strings, then followed targeted professional/institutional biographies. New source pages were fetched with the official source-cache tool; existing pages were reused. Accepted source text was inspected for exact spelling, role and country association. Source URLs remain research/provenance only.
